name: Darksight Goggles
body:
Price 10,500 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7; Weight 1/2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

These goggles lenses are so dark as to seem impenetrable. When worn you can see through them without penalty. If in total darkness the goggles activate granting you darkvision with a range of 30 feet. In addition you gain a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls against creatures without darkvision.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, darkvision
